what: A large panel (opening hours · ticket · show buttons) stuck to the hero’s bottom-right corner drops below by its own height + 30px over .4s power2.out once the hero is fully passed. When fully down, after .1s a small fixed panel (ticket) rises from the same distance below over .4s and stays to the end. Returning to the hero, the small panel drops over .4s and after .05s the large panel rises. On narrow screens (960px and under) there is no large panel, only the small panel floats up from below over .5s

options.dur: Duration of drop-out and rise-in (sec), default .4
options.gap: Delay from when the front panel has fully left until the back panel rises (s), default .1 (half on return)
options.start: Switch point (ScrollTrigger start, relative to this element), default bottom top — when the end of the hero touches the top of the screen
options.narrow: At this width (px) or narrower, only the small plate with no large plate, default 960
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Large panel attached to the hero (child, optional — if absent only the small panel moves up and down)
options.[data-fx-part=float]: Small panel that swaps in and rises up (child)
